g.text: Search progress at equal time | Every seed, all five modes
Full search clock, including cold start | Each panel ends at the shortest measured run among its five modes
A curve starts only once an evaluated champion is available. Incumbents are recorded at completed-generation boundaries (conservative timestamps).

g.text: Cutoffs depend only on run duration, not fitness. Equal-generation and equal-time comparisons answer different questions.
